descriptions.zh: 在§Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§!的庇护所崩塌之前发现了一组受干扰的坐标。我们有理由相信其中的一个坐标是指向一台因内特贸易体用于操纵宇宙风暴的机器。这可是一项值得去找到的科技。
descriptions.en: A set of scrambled coordinates were recovered from §Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§! before the shelter collapsed. We have reason to believe one of these might lead to a machine the Inetian Traders used to manipulate cosmic storms. This could be tech worth the cost to find.

descriptions.zh: §Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§!上的三个坐标拼起了一幅古老的拼图，剩下的事就是激活局部扰动抑制器了。终于到了搞明白它的用途的时候了。
descriptions.en: The three coordinates from §Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§! completed an ancient puzzle. All that is left is to activate the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors. The time has come to discover their purpose.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一处古代星尘沙暴的形成地点，但证据表明，它比典型的风暴要小得多。鉴于它的规模之小，因内特贸易体认为有必要使用他们的局部扰动抑制器来控制风暴就显得很奇怪了。

如果继续追踪风暴的路径，我们也许就能发现他们为什么在这个项目上投入这么多时间。
descriptions.en:
We found the formation point of an ancient celestial dust storm, but evidence suggests it must have been much smaller than a typical disturbance. Given its size, it is curious that the Inetian Traders felt the need to control the storm using their Sectoral Disturbance Depressors.

If we track the path of the storm, we might be able to discover why they invested so much time in this project.

titles.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
titles.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

descriptions.zh: 在发现了因内特贸易体的安息之地后，关于他们辽阔帝国仍有许多未解之谜。我们计划再一次进行调查。
descriptions.en: After having discovered the final resting place of the Inetian Traders there is still more to learn about their vast empire. We would like to investigate them one more time.

descriptions.zh: 坐标指向了一颗位于[planet_assembling_the_past.System.GetName]恒星系内的行星。我们应该派出一艘探索舰船来调查这颗行星与阿达卡利亚公约之间可能存在的关联。
descriptions.en: The coordinates point to a planet in the [planet_assembling_the_past.System.GetName] system. An exploration vessel should be sent to investigate what relevance this planet may have had for the adAkkaria Convention.

descriptions.zh:
我们复原出了阿达卡利亚公约的母行星的坐标。

探索这个星系和行星也许终于能揭示阿达卡利亚文明的命运。
descriptions.en:
We recovered the coordinates to the adAkkaria Convention's home planet.

Exploring the system and planet may finally reveal the fate of the adAkkaria civilization.

titles.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密

descriptions.zh: 庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
descriptions.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

descriptions.zh: 这场在[Owner.Capital.GetName]的千载难逢的风暴具有一种非常适合调制的独特性质。但首先我们必须加深对其构成的理解。谁知道我们会给生活带来什么奇妙的东西呢？
descriptions.en: This once-in-a-lifetime storm system on [Owner.Capital.GetName] has special properties that make it ripe for modulation. But first, we'll need to better understand its underlying composition. Who knows what brilliant oddity we may bring to life?

descriptions.zh: 我们有培植风暴的技术，附近却没有初生的风暴。我们需要研究如何播种出一个可以培植的风暴。
descriptions.en: We have the technology, but without a nascent storm in the vicinity, we will need to investigate how to seed a storm we can sculpt.

descriptions.zh: 小心地将暗物质注入太空织构就可以在这个恒星系中激起可塑的风暴。
descriptions.en: By carefully injecting Dark Matter into the spatial fabric, a malleable storm will be provoked within this system.

descriptions.zh: 我们如今知晓宇宙风暴能靠提供正确的饮食来操控。为了饲育这场风暴，我们需要特定的资源。
descriptions.en: We now know that a cosmic storm can be manipulated by feeding it the correct diet. To feed this one, we require a certain sampling.

descriptions.zh: 创造一场完美的风暴需要一组精心调配的资源。
descriptions.en: Creating the perfect storm will require a carefully measured sampling of resources.

descriptions.zh: 如果我们想要避免这颗星球走向崩坏，就必须要将其稳定下来。
descriptions.en: Stabilizing the collided planet is necessary if we want to prevent this world from collapsing.

descriptions.zh: 执行这个大胆的计划，改造被撞行星的生态环境吧。我们要么创造一个适合所有生命的星球，要么将这颗行星推向毁灭。
descriptions.en: Carry out our ambitious plan to harmonize the biomes of the collided planet. We will either create a world for all, or doom it in the process.

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]地表完全被这些温和的红色昆虫所覆盖。想要行星变得宜居，就要先处理掉这些虫子。与此同时，它们似乎是一种不错的食物来源，或许我们可以从此入手。
descriptions.en: [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered by placid, red insects. The planet could be habitable if the bugs are dealt with. At the same time, they appear to be a good source of food. There may be a path forward here.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一艘科研船上出现了一种特别有趣、非常可爱的动物。我们要先进行调查，再行决定要不要留下它。
descriptions.en: A most intriguing, positively adorable animal was found aboard one of our science vessels. An investigation into the creature's biological qualities is required before we decide to keep it or not.

descriptions.zh:
我们探测到那艘不祥的舰船将会在这场风暴中现身。

派遣一艘科研船去将其引出并捕获！
descriptions.en:
We have detected the ominous ship will be manifesting itself inside this storm.

Send a science vessel to draw it out and intercept it at once!

descriptions.zh: 扫描位于[this.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]，结果表明其内部漩涡中携带着大量物质。远程传感器无法对这一不寻常现象提供确凿的答案。为了增进我们的认识，需要对风暴中心进行一次实地考察。
descriptions.en: Scans of [fromfrom.GetName] in [this.GetName] suggest it is carrying a large mass within its inner vortex. Long-range sensors have been unable to provide conclusive answers about this unusual phenomenon. A field expedition into the eye of the storm is required to advance our understanding.

descriptions.zh: 一个明显受损的神秘胶囊正在飘过§H[this.GetName]§!星系。我们不知道它的起源，也对其功能一无所知。它看起来不具备明显的武器，我们相信对其先进的建造工艺进行分析是一个安全和值得投入的项目。
descriptions.en: A mysterious and visibly-damaged capsule is drifting through the §H[this.GetName]§! system. We know neither its origin nor function. It possesses no evident weaponry and we believe further analysis of its advanced construction would be a safe and worthwhile venture.

descriptions.zh: 一个古老的“风暴陷阱”在太空中自由漂流，内部携带着压缩的宇宙风暴。打开它将为风暴管理和缓解提供宝贵的洞见，但代价是释放被困在里面的未知力量。
descriptions.en: An ancient "storm trap" is drifting freely through space, carrying a compressed cosmic storm within. Opening it would provide valuable insights into storm management and mitigation, at the risk of releasing whatever forces are trapped inside.

descriptions.zh: §Y星尘风暴§!对§H[this.GetName]§!的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
descriptions.en: The impact of a §YStardust Storm§! on §H[this.GetName]§! has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系发现了被宇宙风暴夹带着穿越星系的某种未知生物的遗骸。对待这具遗骸进行法医鉴定可以揭示更多信息。
descriptions.en: We have encountered the remains of an unknown creature in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system dragged across the galaxy by a cosmic storm. Forensic dissection of the corpse should reveal more information.

descriptions.zh: 三只被宇宙风暴从鲸群中带丢的缇扬奇幼崽在[this.solar_system.GetName]星系游荡。我们可以通过放大它们的叫声来帮助它们把鲸群吸引到这个星系中来帮助它们重聚。
descriptions.en: Three Tiyanki calves are lost and wandering the [this.solar_system.GetName] system, separated from their pod by a cosmic storm. We can help reunite them with their pod by boosting their cries to attract the rest of their pod to the system.
